metadata.description: Canonical epoch-1 lifecycle context envelope. This is the one wire shape presented to every extension handler; builtin handlers consume the generated Rust type directly.
Context-envelope epoch. Epoch 1 is the only supported value in R2.4.
Artifacts accumulated from successful earlier contributions. Empty in R2.4, but present on every envelope.
Package slot whose pre/post-install timing event is executing. Absent for phase contributions.
